name: Nippon Avionics Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Avionics Co., Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures and sells data processing systems and related electrical equipment in Japan. The company offers data processing equipment, aviation equipment, communication equipment, image processing equipment, manufacturing equipment, medical equipment, electrical measuring equipment, electronic devices and hybrid IC's, software related to data processing systems and electronic computers, and related equipment and parts. It also provides ultrasonic handheld, automatic seam, and ultrasonic small metal welders for semiconductors and optical devices; security solutions for IoT devices; high-performance welding monitor; resistance, laser, and seam weld…
